concept.title: Multi-Tenant POS System Overview
concept.shortdesc: The Multi-Tenant POS System is a SaaS-based point-of-sale platform that enables businesses to manage stores, branches, products, inventory, orders, customers, payments, refunds, and subscriptions.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Multi-Tenant POS System is a Spring Boot-based REST API application designed to support multiple businesses within a single SaaS platform. Each store can manage its branches, employees, products, inventory, customers, orders, and financial operations.

The system provides role-based access for administrators, store managers, branch managers, branch administrators, cashiers, and customers. Authentication is implemented using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to provide stateless authentication for protected API requests.

section.title: System Architecture
section.p: The application follows a layered architecture consisting of presentation, service, and persistence layers. REST controllers handle API requests, service components implement business logic, and repositories provide access to the MySQL database through Spring Data JPA and Hibernate.
The system also includes security, validation, exception handling, and data-mapping components to support the application workflow.

section.title: Multi-Tenant Model
section.p: The system uses store and branch identifiers to associate business data with the appropriate tenant and branch. This model allows multiple businesses to use the same application while maintaining separation between their operational data.
